findings.current: And even without an expert half a step above him, capturing Jin Taekyung alive rather than killing him would be very difficult.
findings.defect: The draft leaves the expert unidentified, though the sentence refers to Jeok Cheongang.
findings.rationale: 그가 points back to the Fire King, whom the Blood-Sword Demon Lord has just concluded he cannot defeat alone.
findings.replacement: Even without Jeok Cheongang, a master half a step above him, capturing Jin Taekyung alive rather than killing him would be very difficult.
findings.source: 설령 자신보다 반 수 위의 고수인 그가 없다 해도, 진태경을 죽이지 않고 생포하는 것은 매우 어려운 일이 되리라는 것을.

findings.current: The vast army of Dark Heaven had already charged to within a hundred yards.
findings.defect: A hundred jang is approximately 330 yards, not a hundred yards.
findings.rationale: Rendering 장 as yards without conversion makes the approaching force appear more than three times closer.
findings.replacement: The vast army of Dark Heaven had already charged to within roughly three hundred thirty yards.
findings.source: 어느덧 백여 장 앞까지 치달은 암천의 대군세가

findings.current: The two martial brothers of the Fire Gate Clan stood at the heart of the battlefield like iron towers, waiting for the enemy.
findings.defect: Jin Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang are master and disciple, not martial brothers.
findings.rationale: 師弟 denotes their teacher–student relationship here.
findings.replacement: The Fire Gate Clan’s master and disciple stood at the heart of the battlefield like iron towers, waiting for the enemy.
findings.source: 열화문의 두 사제(師弟)는 철탑처럼 전장의 중심에서 적들을 기다렸다.

findings.rationale: The unconverted unit substantially changes the spacing between the combatants and the army.
findings.replacement: About a hundred sixty-five yards away

findings.defect: Thirty jang is approximately a hundred yards.
findings.rationale: The draft makes the enemy more than three times closer than the source does.

findings.current: Sama Pyo gripped the saber he’d taken from one of the Three Elders of Tianshan with both hands.
findings.defect: The draft turns a sword and saber held in both hands into one two-handed saber.
findings.rationale: 도검 names both weapons; the sentence describes Sama Pyo gripping them with his two hands.
findings.replacement: Sama Pyo tightened his grip on the sword and saber that had once belonged to the Three Elders of Tianshan, one in each hand.
findings.source: 사마표가 한때 천산삼노의 것이었던 도검을 양손에 힘주어 그러쥔 그때였다.

findings.defect: Twenty jang is approximately sixty-six yards.
findings.rationale: The unconverted unit changes how near the enemy is during this exchange.

findings.current: Unlike him, Jin Taekyung had been born into the orthodox faction.
findings.defect: The draft equates 定道, a set path, with the orthodox faction and changes what Sama Pyo envies.
findings.rationale: The source writes 定道 rather than 正派; Sama Pyo is contrasting their perceived paths, not stating Jin’s factional birth.
findings.replacement: Unlike him, Jin Taekyung had been born with a path already laid out for him.
findings.source: 그와 달리, 진태경은 정도(定道)에서 태어났으니까.

findings.defect: Ten jang is approximately thirty-three yards.
findings.rationale: The draft places the descending riders substantially closer than the source does.

summary: The draft changes a master–disciple relationship, Sama Pyo’s weapons, Jin Taekyung’s characterization, and five battlefield distances.
